title: Sign in with your organization: the window's button, its Cancel, and the worker running the flow
spec: The sign-in screen has a 'Sign in with your organization' button that needs only the email and sends Action::SignInExternal; while the browser page is open (Update::WaitingForBrowser, ignored unless a sign-in is in progress) it says so and offers Cancel (Action::CancelSignIn); any other update ends the wait. The controller checks the email and hands both to the worker. Worker::sign_in_external runs external_flow::run_unless on the worker's thread with the system browser (Worker::start_with_browser takes another), reports WaitingForBrowser once the page is open, and takes over the session like a password sign-in (SignedIn, resume ticket kept). Worker::cancel_sign_in, or dropping the worker, ends the wait at once (Loopback::wait_unless, LoopbackError::Cancelled); a cancel before a sign-in does not cancel it. Each failure has its own Problem: ExternalNotOffered, ExternalRefused (the finish refused), Browser, NoRedirect, BrowserTimedOut, ProviderRefused, Cancelled.
